name: Add infra restore command for self-hosted postgres backups
description:
Restore a self-hosted postgres backup declared with postgres.backup(db) in .repo-infra/infra.luau. Managed DigitalOcean databases are restored with DigitalOcean's own tools; copying data elsewhere is the db copy issue.

Command:
  infra restore <database> --list
  infra restore <database> [--dump <key> | --at <time>] [--into <name>] [--yes]
<database> is the Luau database name (api, reports, crm), not a compose service.

Flow:
1. Evaluate infra.luau; find the postgres.backup whose database has that name (bucket, prefix, credentials). Fail if none backs it.
2. List dumps under the prefix: --list prints them, default newest, --at newest at or before, --dump exact key.
3. SSH to the host running the backup compose stack and run `docker compose run --rm backup restore <key>`. The sidecar already has db network reach (dbNet or trusted source), Spaces credentials and a matching pg_restore, so the CLI needs no db driver. Requires the sidecar image to support a restore subcommand.
4. Safety: show db, dump (key, time, size) and host; require typing the database name unless --yes. --into restores into a new database (default way to verify a dump / run a drill). Restoring over the live db drops and recreates objects and warns about apps still using it (infra.app referencing that Database).

Prerequisites: Spectre.Console.Cli commands, Luau evaluation via NuLua, secret resolution, SSH client.
